name: LeRobot Project Pulse
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: A Gradio dashboard to monitor key metrics for the LeRobot project, including GitHub statistics, Discord community size, PyPI downloads, and Hugging Face dataset and model adoption.

main is protected: changes must arrive through a reviewed pull request with passing code scanning and signed commits. An unattended six-hourly bot commit satisfies none of those, so the workflow persists the snapshot on the unprotected snapshot-data branch instead.

That branch is data, not source. Nothing is ever merged back into main from it, and it is rebuilt from main on every run, so the push is intentionally a force push. The copy of data/dashboardsnapshot.json committed on main is only a seed for local development and for the very first run; the workflow refuses to publish if a refresh would shorten the accumulated history.
features: Ecosystem Overview -- Cross-source KPIs with 3-month growth rates, dataset/model mix, and a year of publication history seeded from Hub creation dates.
Datasets Tab -- Summary metrics, top datasets by downloads/likes, top contributors, and cumulative growth charts for LeRobot-tagged datasets on the Hub.
Models Tab -- Same comprehensive view for LeRobot-tagged models.
GitHub & Community Tab -- Narrative-driven view organized into sections:
Project Momentum -- Stars, optional two-year star backfill, and PyPI downloads with trend context.
